in_sanskrit.name: सुवोजित
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Suvojit is derived from the Sanskrit words 'su' meaning good, wise, or excellent and 'vojit' meaning victorious or conqueror. It signifies a person who is good, wise, intelligent, and victorious.

in_hindi.name: सुवोजित
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Suvojit in Hindi is translated as 'acchha' meaning good, 'sundar' meaning beautiful, 'jñānadeep' meaning knowledgeable and intelligent, and 'vijayī' meaning victorious.

in_tamil.name: ஸுவோஜித்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Suvojit in Tamil is translated as 'iyalpikum' meaning prosperous, 'acchaa' meaning good, and 'vijayaat' meaning victorious.

in_telugu.name: సువోజిత్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Suvojit in Telugu is translated as 'aasheesh' meaning calm and peaceful, 'jñānēśa' meaning lord of knowledge, 'shamila-dara' meaning steadfast, and 'vijayēśa' meaning lord of victory.

in_marathi.name: Suvojit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Suvojit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। He who conducts himself well and has good conduct.

in_bengali.name: Suvojit
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Good Conduct
in_bengali.long_meaning: Suvojit একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। He who conducts himself well and has good conduct.
